visual_language.medium: Modernist illustrated-book print: letterpress typography, lithographic and etched line, photogravure/newsprint textures, ink wash, graphite, colored pencil, map fragments, and hand marginalia on warm rag paper.
visual_language.surface: Cream-to-grey paper fiber, deckled or trimmed book edges, letterpress bite, newsprint tooth, ink spread, plate tone, erased graphite, and palimpsest traces remain visible; the deck should feel printed, annotated, reread, and carried through Dublin.
visual_language.mark_making: Crosshatch, drypoint scratch, lithographic crayon, flowing pen line, ruled map/grid marks, type fragments, correction marks, handwritten glosses, and episode-specific textual devices coexist without becoming a scrapbook.
visual_language.signature_accent: Wine-dark blue, Guinness gold, Irish green, brick/rust, and occasional violet or ecclesiastical gold act as recurring print accents against Dublin greys, parchment, brown ink, and black type.
visual_language.finish: A tactile modernist edition of one day: literary, urban, embodied, intellectually restless, funny, dirty, tender, and formally experimental while remaining legible as a coherent printed deck.
avoid: one decorative Art Nouveau filter across every episode
clean vector typography with no print materiality
making every card solemn or monumental
